worm.definition:
n. any of numerous relatively small elongated soft-bodied animals especially of the phyla Annelida and Chaetognatha and Nematoda and Nemertea and Platyhelminthes; also many insect larvae
n. a person who has a nasty or unethical character undeserving of respect
n. a software program capable of reproducing itself that can spread from one computer to the next over a network
n. screw thread on a gear with the teeth of a worm wheel or rack
worm.translation:
n. 虫, 蠕虫, 小人物, 螺纹, 蜗杆
vi. 蠕行, 慢慢前进
vt. 使蠕行, 慢慢地走, 除虫
[计] 蠕虫病毒

worm feeder.translation: [化] 螺旋给料机; 螺旋给料器

worm fence.translation: n. 曲折的篱笆, 弯弯曲曲的栅栏; 之形栅栏

worm oneself into.translation: 满满地爬入…,设法取得…,混进…

worm oneself into sb's confidence.translation: 用狡猾手段逐渐骗取某人的信任

worm out.translation: 满满地爬出,设法摆脱,渐渐探听出…

worm press.translation: [化] 螺杆压出机; 螺旋压力机

worm snake.translation: na. 【动】盲蛇科或蠕蛇科动物

worm-eaten.definition: s infested with or damaged (as if eaten) by worms
worm-eaten.translation: a. 虫蛀的, 陈旧的, 破烂不堪的

worm-hole.translation: n. 虫眼儿, 虫蛀的洞; 蛀洞

worm-holes.translation: (worm-hole 的复数) n. 虫眼儿, 虫蛀的洞; 蛀洞

worm-muller test.translation: [医] 沃姆·苗勒氏试验(检尿葡萄糖)

worm-muller's test.translation: [医] 沃姆·苗勒氏试验(检尿葡萄糖)

worm-shaped.definition: s resembling a worm; long and thin and cylindrical

wormald.translation: [人名] [英格兰人姓氏] 沃莫尔德住所名称，来源于古英语女子名，含义是“狼+秘密”(wolf+secret)+北方古英语，含义是“泉，溪流”(spring,stream)

wormcast.definition:
n. cylindrical mass of earth voided by a burrowing earthworm or lugworm
n. fossil trail of a worm

wormed.definition:
imp. & p. p. of Worm
a. Penetrated by worms; injured by worms; worm-eaten; as,
   wormed timber.
wormed.translation: vt.& vi. 蠕动, 曲折行进（worm的过去式与过去分词形式）

wormers.translation: (wormer 的复数)  [地名] [荷兰] 沃尔默

wormhole.definition: n. hole made by a burrowing worm

wormholed.translation: a. 多蛀孔的, 虫蚀的

wormholes.definition: n. hole made by a burrowing worm
wormholes.translation: n. 虫洞（wormhole 的复数形式）

wormier.translation: a. 有虫的, 虫蛀的；似虫的；卑躬屈膝的 (wormy的变形)

wormless.translation: a. 无蠕虫的, 无蛀虫的, 无寄生虫的

wormley's test.translation: [医] 沃姆利氏试验(检生物硷)
